description: Deal Pipeline Contribution Tree by Office Solution The Deal Pipeline Contribution Tree visualizes complex deal flow hierarchies, M&A pipelines, and enterprise sales opportunities in Power BI. It breaks down portfolio pipelines from macro divisions down to individual mandate opportunities across interactive horizontal tree levels. Each node card integrates expected value (EV), win probabilities, and contribution shares, while smooth branching connectors illustrate how sub-segments build up to total pipeline value. Key Concepts: Pipeline Hierarchy Tree: Multi-level horizontal drilldown from top portfolio down to divisions, coverage sectors, deal stages, and individual mandates. Probability-Weighted Valuation: Calculates expected fees and expected pipeline values by factoring stage conversion probabilities against gross amounts. Contribution & Variance Nodes: Cards display weighted fees, gross deal values, win probability %, budget variance, and parent contribution progress bars with child count badges. Key Features: Dual-Period Compare Mode: Compare two periods (e.g., Q4 vs Q3 or Current vs Prior) side-by-side to track pipeline velocity, deal drift, and stage progression. Top-N + Residual "Other" Grouping: Filter and focus on highest-value contributors while automatically aggregating residual mandates into an interactive "Other Deals" node.
